meta.title: 方圆脸快来变美，复制明星同款头包脸。
meta.title_en: Round Faces: Copy the Celebrity Head-Wrap Look

scenes.title_cn: 开场：头包脸 vs 脸包头
scenes.context: 方圆脸姐妹都有这样的困扰，今天复刻明星同款头包脸，三分钟从这样变成这样，主打披发扎发都好看。
sentences: Copy the celebrity hair-wrapped head look.
paraphrase: Copy the celebrity hair-wrapped head look.
scenes.speak: Copy the celebrity hair-wrapped head look. Looks great up or down.

scenes.context: 脸包头就是颅顶低、贴头皮、捏去扁、整个头发没有厚度，看起来脸的面积比头发多。
sentences: A face-wrap has a flat, low crown.
paraphrase: A face-wrap has a flat, low crown.
scenes.speak: A face-wrap has a flat, low crown. The hair lacks volume.

scenes.context: 头包脸就是不管正面还是侧面，整个轮廓都是圆润饱满的，头发包住脸。
sentences: A hair-wrap gives a round, full outline.
paraphrase: A hair-wrap gives a round, full outline.
scenes.speak: A hair-wrap gives a round, full outline. Full from every angle.

scenes.context: 烫发工具像马赛克一样，选窄板不选特别宽的；给头发分区，摸过来有两个骨头的地方绝对不能烫。
sentences: Don't curl where the skull bones sit.
paraphrase: Don't curl where the skull bones sit.
scenes.speak: Pick a narrow straightener plate. Don't curl where the skull bones sit.

scenes.context: 从前面把线找出来到顶点，顶点是耳尖往上的中间位置也就是天灵盖；后面整骨最扁的手掌大区域不要烫。
sentences: The crown sits above the ear tip.
paraphrase: The crown sits above the ear tip.
scenes.speak: The crown sits above the ear tip. Skip the flattest occiput area.

scenes.context: 分区对了但烫的角度很重要，把发片拿起来垂直于头皮，夹板完全贴到发根，停留五到十秒钟。
sentences: Hold the section perpendicular to the scalp.
Press the plate to the roots.
paraphrase: Hold the section perpendicular to the scalp.
Press the plate to the roots.
scenes.speak: Hold the section perpendicular to the scalp. Press the plate to the roots.

scenes.context: 耳后括弧这个地方很多姐妹想让头发厚起来，会显得脸小，可以多停留一下，冷却完才能定型。
sentences: Volume behind the ears slims the face.
Let it cool to set the curl.
paraphrase: Volume behind the ears slims the face.
Let it cool to set the curl.
scenes.speak: Volume behind the ears slims the face. Let it cool to set the curl.

scenes.context: 颅顶不能全部烫，两指宽只烫这么多，分成两次烫，先烫最外面的这一片，提拉角度很重要。
sentences: Curl only two fingers wide at the crown.
paraphrase: Curl only two fingers wide at the crown.
scenes.speak: Curl only two fingers wide at the crown. The lift angle is key.

practice: A hair-wrap gives a round, full outline.
The crown sits above the ear tip.
Let it cool to set the curl.
